title: selfdoc maps a report change to the docs that cite the report section it changed, not the whole report
goal: selfdoc stale lists a doc as stale after a report change only when the doc cites a section the change touched; SP-3pvz2noj: rows appended to one section of benchmarks.md made design.md and token-efficiency.md stale at land (ST-xjtqwdtq, stopped at step stale) though both cite other sections

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import inspect, selfdoc
assert 'section' in inspect.getsource(selfdoc.stale) if hasattr(selfdoc, 'stale') else False, 'stale maps whole files'
